correctness.rationale: The two-step y return forces x1=-x0; primitive cycles have nonzero x0. Both first-coordinate steps then force a=-2(1+y0^2)=-2(1+y1^2), with y1=-y0. Thus one unordered orbit exists exactly if a<-2. The identical cycle Jacobians M have trace zero and M^2=((1-7u^2)/(1+u^2))I=(-7-16/a)I. Strict monotonicity gives the exact sink and source intervals, double -1 point and zero return Jacobian; local superattraction follows from the C2 Taylor estimate.
